description: ocsp.rs:50 starts a new bullet '- SingleResponse matching uses both serial number...' that is textually outside the Limitations section above it but inside the struct docblock. The Limitations section ends at line 49, and lines 50-66 add post-limitation bullet points directly in the struct doc without a section header. This makes the struct docstring structurally ambiguous (are those bullets sub-bullets of the last Limitation or standalone notes?). Add a '# Notes' or '# Behavior' section header before line 50 to clarify the structure.
title: pkix-revocation: OcspChecker doc block has misplaced bullet point
